generation.mechanism: Enhanced electron-phonon coupling leads to the formation of Cooper pairs, which are essential for superconductivity.
generation.predicted_outcome: An increase in the critical temperature (Tc) for superconductivity in materials with strong electron-phonon coupling when validated through simulations.
